task_families.supported_role: Translate decision, unit, intervention, comparator, population, horizon and loss into explicit alternatives. CausalDS and CLadder expose task definitions; the copilot/OCI sources propose assisted formulation.
task_families.adverse_findings_and_knowledge_gap: A fluent paraphrase can silently change ATE to ATT, a trimmed target, a policy value or a prediction. No source certifies the intended banking estimand.
task_families.next_action: LA02 must keep unresolved alternatives and obtain scientific ownership before committing to one target.

task_families.supported_role: Ontology extraction and quantitative knowledge retrieval can propose variable definitions and semantic relations; benchmark observation models expose conceptual/proxy distinctions.
task_families.adverse_findings_and_knowledge_gap: Taxonomic edges are not causal arrows; extracted labels do not establish ownership, measurement validity or availability time.
task_families.next_action: LA02 requires measured-versus-latent types, event/availability clocks, units and a link to the original observation record.

task_families.supported_role: Retrieval, soft priors and assumption-evidence audits support hypothesis elicitation and conflict review.
task_families.adverse_findings_and_knowledge_gap: Retrieval worsens selected discovery cells; source absence and retrieval failure differ; agreement and model ratings are not causal truth.
task_families.next_action: LA02/LA03 attach citations, counterevidence, disputed alternatives and an explicit refusal state to every claim.

task_families.supported_role: Pairwise/CI prompts, breadth-first graph proposals and interactive graph editing provide distinct diagram workflows.
task_families.adverse_findings_and_knowledge_gap: Cycle rejection establishes syntax only. Prompt direction or a graph editor must not erase CPDAG/PAG equivalence or latent confounding.
task_families.next_action: LA02/LA03 preserve endpoint marks, temporal order, graph revisions and separate proposal versus approved-assumption layers.

task_families.supported_role: The corpus contains LLM-only, retrieval, statistical reweighting, soft-prior and multi-agent alternatives with author-reported benchmark comparisons.
task_families.adverse_findings_and_knowledge_gap: Memorization, prompt instability, wrong-domain evidence and model-response tests undermine unqualified discovery claims. Reported small-benchmark gains do not imply effect coverage.
task_families.next_action: LA03 and LA06 compare data-only baselines and registered label, retrieval and prompt perturbations; preserve every failed case.

task_families.supported_role: Noisy-prior PAG work, sufficient temporal initialization, numerical temporal foundation models and latent mechanism proposals occupy different statistical regimes.
task_families.adverse_findings_and_knowledge_gap: Batch-sequential discovery is not longitudinal policy identification. RealTCD and LCM sufficiency restrictions cannot be removed by language suggestions; MDA finite prediction tests do not identify arbitrary latent mechanisms.
task_families.next_action: LA03 retains temporal/PAG assumptions and the unresolved R04 effect-set boundary; no blanket latent-temporal qualification.

task_families.supported_role: The sources cover learned experiment strategies, noisy expert queries and numerical information-gain surrogates over proposed mechanisms.
task_families.adverse_findings_and_knowledge_gap: Querying an LLM is not intervening on a bank. EIG within a misspecified pool is not expected bank profit; pruning can discard a later useful model.
task_families.next_action: Specify permitted experiments, cost and decision loss; compare random and numerical designs with the same acquisition budget.

task_families.supported_role: Formal benchmark generators and algorithm-assisted workflows can separate adjustment, front-door/ID, counterfactual queries and nonidentification.
task_families.adverse_findings_and_knowledge_gap: PyWhy-LLM front-door is unimplemented in the inspected revision; the CLadder IV template needs extra assumptions; LLM-generated counterfactual truth is not an independent oracle.
task_families.next_action: Use a separate formal engine and a three-state identified/not-identified/unknown result; quarantine unsupported IV labels.

task_families.supported_role: Agents can prepare typed specifications, request data summaries and orchestrate fixed causal tools; static sources expose notebook and package boundaries.
task_families.adverse_findings_and_knowledge_gap: Unbounded notebook execution, mutable ontology downloads, unbound tool functions and empty-JSON fallbacks prevent direct adoption as a trustworthy runtime.
task_families.next_action: LA04/LA05 adapt fixed audited operations with hashed artifacts, bounded jobs and explicit failure rather than running generated code.

task_families.supported_role: Medical copilot roadmaps discuss complex causal tasks; passive strategy experiments and MDA provide adjacent sequential/latent examples. OCI supplies a static observational workflow.
task_families.adverse_findings_and_knowledge_gap: This inspected corpus provides no locally qualified LLM-assisted longitudinal g-method, off-policy inference or closed-loop bank policy. Alaa is a roadmap, OCI is not longitudinal, and MDA uses open-loop experiments.
task_families.next_action: Develop the explicit longitudinal target/clock/assignment contract in LA02/LA04, retain missing primary implementation evidence and the failed targeted searches, and do not invent a working package.

task_families.supported_role: OCI and CausalDS connect estimation to diagnostics, target definitions, abstention and interval scoring; ARGUS audits reported identification evidence.
task_families.adverse_findings_and_knowledge_gap: Trimming changes the target; balance and placebo checks cannot verify unconfoundedness; missing identification metadata and capped scores can conceal failure.
task_families.next_action: Separate target, identification, statistical calibration and diagnostic results; require uncapped losses and explicit unknown states.

task_families.supported_role: Actor/critic reports and evidence audits can expose assumptions, provenance, unmet conditions and required domain review.
task_families.adverse_findings_and_knowledge_gap: These are not validated drift alarms or external acceptance. A retrieved statement of an assumption is not proof that it holds.
task_families.next_action: LA04 defines assumption/source/version invalidation, explicit monitoring ownership and report generation from fixed result objects.

task_families.supported_role: Conversational MCP tools, actor/critic notebooks, a protected discovery core and mechanism-proposal loops are concrete architectural alternatives.
task_families.adverse_findings_and_knowledge_gap: Generic orchestration and transport do not supply identification algorithms, license clearance, error semantics or deployment qualification.
task_families.next_action: LA04 connects typed handoffs to IN02/IN04; distinguish static source review, local conformance and external platform acceptance.

task_families.supported_role: The evidence spans formal causal queries, numerical data-science tasks, contamination probes, interface studies and sample-efficiency experiments.
task_families.adverse_findings_and_knowledge_gap: Small public graphs, shared evaluation models, staged user studies, unmatched compute and selected success denominators prevent broad effectiveness or ROI claims.
task_families.next_action: LA06 preregisters novel mechanisms/labels, independent oracles, valid abstention, effect loss, full cost and all-request availability.

source_audit.anchor: Identity, exact local sources, inspected primary anchors, supported claims and limits

scope_limit: Every required task family is represented; a roadmap or negative result is not mislabeled as a working capability. Uninspected relevant candidates remain in omissions.
